scan_notes: Today's q-fin new submissions (Apr 22-23) were thin on directly actionable papers. Most relevant papers were from the Apr 20-21 window that appeared in the full recent listing. The most important finding is the full-paper confirmation that anti-extrapolation prompting is ineffective (updating an existing heuristic that was partly wrong). The backtest regime haircut formula is a highly actionable, quantified complement to our existing MRP and friction buffer heuristics.
